scenario.title: Ordering at a cafe
scenario.setting: A small cafe in London in the morning.
scenario.goal: Order a drink and a snack, and ask for the price.
scenario.openingLine: Good morning! What can I get for you today?

recentTurns.content: Good morning! What can I get for you today?
Hello, I want a coffee and a cake.

responses.text: {"reply":"A coffee and a cake, great choice. That comes to five pounds. Would you like it for here or to take away?","hint":"You can say: For here, please."}
